title: SB2866 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2022-02-03; official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514133950 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/SB2866.pdf (LegiScan doc 2504560))
provenance.note: Draft as filed 2022-02-02 (HB 2524 / SB 2866), the "Second Amendment Simplification Act of 2022." Replaces 39-17-1307 with a single prohibited-possessor offense and deletes 39-17-1308 (carry with intent to go armed, defenses) and 39-17-1311 (weapon in park or recreation building). Sections 2(b)-(c) list relief and federal-dealer exceptions. Effective July 1, 2022.

SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (1) A person commits an offense who possesses a firearm and:
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (C) Has been convicted of any other felony;
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (D) Has been convicted of a misdemeanor crime of domestic violence as defined in 18 U.S.C. § 921, and is still subject to the disabilities of such a conviction; or
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1307(a)): (E) Is, at the time of the possession, subject to an order of protection that fully complies with 18 U.S.C. § 922(g)(8).
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1307(d)): (d) A person does not possess a firearm, including, but not limited to, a firearm registered under the National Firearms Act (26 U.S.C. § 5801 et seq.), if the firearm is in a safe or similar container that is securely locked and to which the person does not have the combination, keys, or other means of normal access.
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1308): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1308, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 4 (TCA 39-17-1311): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1311, is amended by deleting the section in its entirety.
SECTION 5 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): deleting the language "or who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(g)".
